# Security Policy

Welcome to the Cosmeron Security Policy!

We take the security of Cosmeron and its community seriously. If you've discovered a vulnerability, we appreciate you taking the time to report it and help us make the project safer for everyone.

This guide explains how to report security issues and how we'll handle responsible disclosures.

You can read the full policy in your preferred language:
 [Português](../Docs/pt/Governance/SECURITY.md) | [English](../Docs/en/Governance/SECURITY.md) | [Español](../Docs/es/Governance/SECURITY.md)

Found a security vulnerability? Please use this repository's Private vulnerability reporting feature instead of opening a public issue. This helps us investigate and address the problem safely before any details become public.

Thanks for helping keep Cosmeron safe!
